brief:
The European Union is hosting a lobbying summit sponsored by an Israeli weapons manufacturer that plays a "pivotal role" in the Gaza war, the Electronic Intifada reported. The event brings together EU officials and the arms industry, establishing direct institutional engagement between European decision-makers and Israeli military producers.

The sponsorship arrangement connects European governments with Israeli defense contractors supplying weapons used in Gaza operations. The summit reflects a pattern of EU institutional participation in events organized by Israel's defense sector.
dek: Firm that plays “pivotal role” in Gaza war sponsors lobbying summit.
title: EU hosts weapons industry summit sponsored by Israeli arms firm
